title.narrative: Women on the digital move (WODIMO) ¿ income opportunities and enhanced social protection of informal migrant workers beyond COVID-19

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To support decent work for women migrant workers in the informal sector and to improve their access to social protection during and beyond COVID-19 pandemic Outcome 1: Informal women migrant workers have increased digital income generation opportunities Outcome 2: Improved social protection regulations for informal workers Women informal migrant workers using online platforms, Tu Luc Self-help groups (networks of informal migrant workers), CSOs and their networks and governmental institutions Informal migrant workers Op 1.1 Technologically capable informal women migrant workers use relevant existing online marketplaces to connect with customers and suppliers and to access information; Op. 1.2 A niche hub of low-income informal workers is established and operational on existing online marketplaces; Op. 2.1 Evidence for challenges informal workers face due to COVID-19 and in accessing social protection collected and documented; Op.2.2 Informal migrant workers are more confident to advocate for their right of social protection; Op. 2.3 Relevant policymakers recognise the informal migrant workers challenges in accessing social protection regulations and respond to it by revising/reinforcing the implementation of related policies
